elements.description: An AI answer with numbered source markers, source chips and an in-place source preview.

properties.name: segments
properties.description: The answer as text segments, each naming the sources it relies on – a numbered marker ends each cited one

properties.name: sources
properties.description: The sources, numbered in this order – chips under the answer and the passages their previews quote

properties.name: pagesRead
properties.description: Pages the model read while searching – shown in the head next to the source count

properties.name: preview
properties.description: Id of the source whose preview is open (null: closed)

properties.name: openHandled
properties.description: The app opens sources itself (it listens to tc-open-source): links don't navigate, and sources without a url get Open source too

properties.name: actionLabel
properties.description: A button on the tray that fires tc-action, e.g. "Follow up"

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-preview-change
events.description: The open preview changes; detail `{ preview: string | null }` (null: closed). Cancelable.

events.name: tc-open-source
events.description: Open source was pressed; detail `{ source: CitedSource }`

props.name: sources
props.description: The sources, numbered in this order – chips under the answer and the passages their previews quote

props.name: preview
props.description: Id of the source whose preview is open – controlled when defined (null: closed)

props.name: defaultPreview
props.description: Id of the source whose preview is open at first (uncontrolled)

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The old name of `defaultPreview`, still read when that's unset

props.name: onOpenSource
props.description: Called by Open source. With it the link doesn't navigate on its own – open the page yourself

props.name: onPreviewChange
props.description: Called when the open preview changes (null = closed)

props.name: action
props.description: A button on the tray, e.g. { label: "Follow up", onClick }
